name: Cydian
subtitle: A package manager with the iOS 6 look
description: Cydian's own source: the Cydian app for iPhones without a jailbreak.

apps.name: Cydian
apps.subtitle: Packages and apps with the iOS 6 look
apps.localizedDescription: Cydian lists apps from AltStore-style sources and, on a jailbroken iPhone, tweaks and themes from APT repos, with the iOS 6 look. The app signs apps on your iPhone with your own certificate (no server) and scrolls at 120Hz. Free and open source (GPL-3.0-or-later).

versions.localizedDescription:
Essential: Cydian now uses its new install server, sign.cydian.dev (a Cloudflare Worker anyone can host for free: worker/README.md). Signing still happens on your iPhone.
After Cydian updates itself it closes, with a notification to open the new version.
Reload works like Cydia's (spinner in the button, no flash).
More from the runner (I4, F87).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.3.3

Install, Upgrade and Version History go through Cydia's Confirm and queue; Custom Install for any app (bundle ID, name, icon, extensions); the Essential Upgrade alert queues too.
Confirm looks like Cydia's on the 4S: Continue Queuing, Statistics, Modifications.
Cydian opens AltStore, SideStore and Feather links (Settings to turn it off).
Search: the bar stays put, with iOS 6's clear button.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.3.2

Confirm and queue like Cydia: Install, Upgrade, Reinstall and Upgrade (N) queue apps and open Confirm.
Links into other tabs slide in over the page you are on; Back comes back (Install IPAs from Home).
Install IPAs: a search bar (all apps, or the list you are in).
App pages: the first permissions, then N More Permissions.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.3.1

Install IPAs: browse apps from your sources by category, search them, and keep your own IPAs; linked from Home.
Links into another tab slide in.
Sources Add: while iOS shows Paste, the button reads Type (blue): tap it to type a source in.
Cydian checks for essential updates again when you come back to it.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.3.0

Changes: app upgrades show (Available Upgrades, the tab and icon badge) with Upgrade (N); a background check posts a notification when updates come out.
Sources: Add never sticks pressed; tapping Manage while the Paste bubble is up opens Manage.
Installed: My IPAs as a button at the top.
Install errors say what went wrong.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.9

Importing from the website shows one popup (ends on Done); anything that could not be added shows in a passing banner.
A website install brings its settings only on the first launch.
The Home Cydian App card; My IPAs (0.2.7).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.8

My IPAs under Installed: add your own IPAs from Files or a URL, sign them on the phone (offline), install, save or share them.
Home: the Cydian App card (Install Cydian App, Send Settings to App); Featured slides in; the tile says Refreshing Sources while sources load.
Open in Cydian brings your certificate too and imports straight away.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.7

Open in Cydian App brings your certificate, sources and settings, and imports them straight away.
Installing Cydian from the website brings all of it along: ready on first launch, nothing to set up.
Home: by Ryan Hayden (Fizlo).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.6

The app opens on a plain fill that fits every iPhone, then its loading screen (no more cut-off launch screen).
Import your certificate from Safari, or get it built into the app from the website; Open in Cydian App moves your sources and settings (F75).
Badges: Changes and the app icon show the upgrade count at launch; sources refresh in the background with the red spinning badge.
Upgrade/Reinstall on app pages, Discord next to GitHub, the banner moves the bars down, outside links open in Safari.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.5

Share sheet: Open in … apps on app pages too.
The A–Z index no longer fights a list that is still gliding.
Cydian updates itself in one step (signed on the phone, held on the signing server, then iOS's Install prompt).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.4

Cydian updates itself in one step: it signs the update on the phone, the signing server holds it for a few minutes, and iOS asks Install right away.
Install at the top right installs straight away (Download IPA is on the page).
The test apps (Test Alpha, Test Beta...) are no longer mistaken for Cydian.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.3

The Installed tab is back in the app: your apps, and Cydian itself at its real version.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.2

Cydian shows itself in Installed at its real version, so its updates appear in Changes like any app.
Automatic appearance follows iOS, dark mode included (Light stays the default).
Featured opens Popular; the share sheet with Copy Link; the Reloading popup lasts as long as loading.
Fixes: the Add button's Paste state, the page shifting when typing in a popup.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.1

App pages: Install signs with your own certificate and installs; Download IPA keeps the file, on every older version too. No more hand-offs to AltStore, SideStore or Feather.
Installs in the app show only iOS's Install prompt.
Mark as Installed for apps installed another way.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.0

Installing in the app shows only iOS's Install prompt, no Open in iTunes before it.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.1.9

Mark as Installed on app pages: apps installed another way are followed for updates (Change Installed Version, Mark as Not Installed).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.1.8

Signing and installing end on a Done checkmark that fades, so it is clear the app was handed to iOS.
The Signing walkthrough moves to the next step by itself when you come back from Settings.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.1.7

The app opens on Home loading (title, the Loading spinner, the tab bar), like Cydia, instead of a black screen.
Installs in the app: the manifest request gets past the server proxy (0.1.5), and Cydian's built-in source names the newest version.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.1.6

Installs in the app work: the manifest request no longer trips the server proxy.
Install signs straight away; Signing walkthrough; built-in Cydian source and Essential Upgrade.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.1.5
Cydian 0.1.1. Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.1.1
